minor_bugs.issue: Returns 404 when trying to edit document with custom 'id' field instead of MongoDB _id
minor_bugs.impact: DB Manager document editing requires fetching _id first
minor_bugs.note: This is expected behavior - the endpoint correctly requires either MongoDB _id (ObjectId) or a custom 'id' field that exists in the document. Test was using incorrect docId.
